freeze_discipline.why: The external campaign was executed and frozen on 2026-08-24, before this packet existed. This lane runs no campaign, derives no gold, makes no network request and re-evaluates no gate. It proves theorems and compares them against the frozen receipt.
freeze_discipline.commit_boundary_rule_not_applicable: The protocol-before-results commit split exists to make a prospective freeze falsifiable. Here the results predate the packet entirely, so the split would prove nothing; the honest control is the disclosure below rather than a commit boundary.
freeze_discipline.prospectivity_disclosure: The outcomes were readable before the theorems were written. This is explanatory adequacy, NOT prospective validation, and no prospectivity is claimed anywhere in the packet.
post_outcome_changes_forbidden: re-running the campaign or re-deriving gold
selecting arms or metrics after seeing which flatter the thesis
converting any of the 32 CANNOT_CHECK facts
freeze_discipline.arm_and_metric_selection: All four arms and all metrics are taken verbatim from the frozen receipt. None was added, dropped or redefined by this packet.

claims_under_test: Theorem 1: reuse is sound iff every load-bearing premise is UNCHANGED; CONTRADICTED forces REVALIDATE; UNKNOWN forces CANNOT_CHECK.
Theorem 2: if the observable does not determine a load-bearing premise, no observable-measurable policy is both sound and non-vacuous on that class.
Theorem 3: a sound non-vacuous policy's cost is floored by cost(L); achievable reduction is bounded by the non-load-bearing remainder.
Explanatory: the theorems classify all four frozen arms, and every arm cheaper than the cheapest sound arm is unsound or vacuous.

information_matching.requirement_1649: strongest fair baselines must be information/action/budget matched
information_matching.how_satisfied: The comparison is not a tuned contest. always-raw is the exhaustive upper baseline and receives strictly MORE information than lifecycle-rcs; lifecycle-rcs matches its accept behaviour exactly on all 93 cases at 70% of its cost. provenance-only and confidence-only receive strictly LESS information, and the theorems predict in advance which horn each must take.
information_matching.no_arm_advantaged_by_construction: every arm decides the same 93 frozen cases derived under the same gold rule

explicitly_not_claimed: prospective validation -- see the disclosure above
external adjudication; the blinded two-expert protocol remains unexecuted
any governance, quality or responsibility judgment; those remain CANNOT_CHECK
protected confirmation -- the gold rule's non-bypass boundary states that an AI session does not create it, and that applies to this packet
novelty over donor provenance / proof-carrying / incremental-verification machinery

independent_checker_requirements.must_recompute_not_restate: the arm table must be recomputed from the receipt and the theorem classification derived, not transcribed
independent_checker_requirements.cannot_check_rule: exit code 3, status CANNOT_CHECK, never reported as a pass
